definitions.gloss: gastritis; inflammation of the stomach lining
definitions.explanation: A medical condition in which the lining of the stomach becomes inflamed, causing symptoms such as stomach pain, nausea, and discomfort.

examples.japanese: {胃炎|いえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胃炎|いえん}になった。

{慢性的|まんせいてき}な{胃炎|いえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされていた→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}したら→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}した→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧。
examples.english: I had been suffering from chronic gastritis, but it improved after I reviewed my eating habits.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach) and {炎|えん} (inflammation). The {炎|えん} suffix is productive in medical terminology: ⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ (pneumonia), {腸炎|ちょうえん} (enteritis), {肝炎|かんえん} (hepatitis), etc. Knowing this pattern helps learners decode many medical terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧{胃炎|いえん}: acute gastritis
- ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{胃炎|いえん}: chronic gastritis
- {胃炎|いえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: gastritis medication
- {胃炎|いえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop gastritis
- {萎縮性|いしゅくせい}{胃炎|いえん}: atrophic gastritis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胃潰瘍|いかいよう}→胃潰瘍：26958_ikaiyou⟧: stomach ulcer — more severe than {胃炎|いえん}; involves damage to the stomach lining
- ⟦{胃痛|いつう}→胃痛：18319_itsuu⟧: stomachache — a symptom rather than a diagnosis
- {胃腸炎|いちょうえん}: gastroenteritis — inflammation of both the stomach and intestines
